bio.text: Eon Tyrell Huntley won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for New York State Assembly District 56 in Brooklyn, defeating incumbent Stefani Zinerman, and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines.

According to his campaign website, he grew up in East New York, attended New York City public schools and the Parsons School of Design, worked as a fashion designer and clothing salesman, and has lived in Bedford-Stuyvesant for 18 years.
His campaign website also says he is a retail worker, served on the bargaining committee of Workers United Local 340, and was a three-term PTA president.
